FROM fact_inbound_shipment

(SELECT anon_2.fact_id AS fact_id, CASE WHEN (anon_2.open_qty > anon_2.shipped_qty) THEN anon_2.open_qty - anon_2.shipped_qty ELSE %(param_1)s::INTEGER END AS counted_qty 
FROM (SELECT fact_inbound_shipment_1.id AS fact_id, lower(fact_inbound_shipment_1.line_state) AS state, coalesce(fact_inbound_shipment_1.quantity, %(coalesce_3)s::INTEGER) AS open_qty, sum(CASE WHEN (lower(fact_inbound_shipment_1.line_state) = %(lower_1)s::VARCHAR) THEN coalesce(fact_inbound_shipment_1.quantity, %(coalesce_4)s::INTEGER) ELSE %(param_2)s::INTEGER END) OVER (PARTITION BY fact_inbound_shipment_1.tenant_id, lower(trim(coalesce(fact_inbound_shipment_1.operating_unit, ''))), lower(trim(fact_inbound_shipment_1.order_no)), lower(trim(fact_inbound_shipment_1.item_code))) AS shipped_qty, sum(CASE WHEN (lower(fact_inbound_shipment_1.line_state) = %(lower_1)s::VARCHAR) THEN %(param_3)s::INTEGER ELSE %(param_4)s::INTEGER END) OVER (PARTITION BY fact_inbound_shipment_1.tenant_id, lower(trim(coalesce(fact_inbound_shipment_1.operating_unit, ''))), lower(trim(fact_inbound_shipment_1.order_no)), lower(trim(fact_inbound_shipment_1.item_code))) AS n_shipped 
FROM fact_inbound_shipment AS fact_inbound_shipment_1 
WHERE fact_inbound_shipment_1.order_no IS NOT NULL AND fact_inbound_shipment_1.item_code IS NOT NULL AND trim(fact_inbound_shipment_1.order_no) != '' AND trim(fact_inbound_shipment_1.item_code) != '' AND lower(fact_inbound_shipment_1.line_state) IN (%(lower_2_1)s::VARCHAR, %(lower_2_2)s::VARCHAR) AND fact_inbound_shipment_1.tenant_id = %(tid_1)s::VARCHAR) AS anon_2 
WHERE anon_2.state = %(state_1)s::VARCHAR AND anon_2.n_shipped > %(n_shipped_1)s::INTEGER)
 SELECT coalesce(fact_inbound_shipment.resolved_distributor_id, fact_inbound_shipment.distributor_id) AS distributor_id, fact_inbound_shipment.product_id, coalesce(sum(coalesce(anon_1.counted_qty, fact_inbound_shipment.quantity)), %(coalesce_2)s::INTEGER) AS coalesce_1 
FROM fact_inbound_shipment LEFT OUTER JOIN anon_1 ON anon_1.fact_id = fact_inbound_shipment.id 
WHERE fact_inbound_shipment.purchase_order_id IS NOT NULL AND fact_inbound_shipment.product_id IS NOT NULL AND coalesce(fact_inbound_shipment.resolved_distributor_id, fact_inbound_shipment.distributor_id) IS NOT NULL AND (fact_inbound_shipment.line_state = %(line_state_1)s::VARCHAR AND fact_inbound_shipment.pod_date IS NULL OR fact_inbound_shipment.line_state IN (%(line_state_2_1)s::VARCHAR, %(line_state_2_2)s::VARCHAR)) AND (anon_1.fact_id IS NULL OR anon_1.counted_qty > %(counted_qty_1)s::INTEGER) AND fact_inbound_shipment.tenant_id = %(tid_1)s::VARCHAR GROUP BY coalesce(fact_inbound_shipment.resolved_distributor_id, fact_inbound_shipment.distributor_id), fact_inbound_shipment.product_id

stmts.sql:
WITH anon_1 AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT anon_2.fact_id AS fact_id, CASE WHEN (anon_2.open_qty > anon_2.shipped_qty) THEN anon_2.open_qty - anon_2.shipped_qty ELSE %(param_1)s::INTEGER END AS counted_qty 
FROM (SELECT fact_inbound_shipment_1.id AS fact_id, lower(fact_inbound_shipment_1.line_state) AS state, coalesce(fact_inbound_shipment_1.quantity, %(coalesce_3)s::INTEGER) AS open_qty, sum(CASE WHEN (lower(fact_inbound_shipment_1.line_state) = %(lower_1)s::VARCHAR) THEN coalesce(fact_inbound_shipment_1.quantity, %(coalesce_4)s::INTEGER) ELSE %(param_2)s::INTEGER END) OVER (PARTITION BY fact_inbound_shipment_1.tenant_id, lower(trim(coalesce(fact_inbound_shipment_1.operating_unit, ''))), lower(trim(fact_inbound_shipment_1.order_no)), lower(trim(fact_inbound_shipment_1.item_code))) AS shipped_qty, sum(CASE WHEN (lower(fact_inbound_shipment_1.line_state) = %(lower_1)s::VARCHAR) THEN %(param_3)s::INTEGER ELSE %(param_4)s::INTEGER END) OVER (PARTITION BY fact_inbound_shipment_1.tenant_id, lower(trim(coalesce(fact_inbound_shipment_1.operating_unit, ''))), lower(trim(fact_inbound_shipment_1.order_no)), lower(trim(fact_inbound_shipment_1.item_code))) AS n_shipped 
FROM fact_inbound_shipment AS fact_inbound_shipment_1 
WHERE fact_inbound_shipment_1.order_no IS NOT NULL AND fact_inbound_shipment_1.item_code IS NOT NULL AND trim(fact_inbound_shipment_1.order_no) != '' AND trim(fact_inbound_shipment_1.item_code) != '' AND lower(fact_inbound_shipment_1.line_state) IN (%(lower_2_1)s::VARCHAR, %(lower_2_2)s::VARCHAR) AND fact_inbound_shipment_1.tenant_id = %(tid_1)s::VARCHAR) AS anon_2 
WHERE anon_2.state = %(state_1)s::VARCHAR AND anon_2.n_shipped > %(n_shipped_1)s::INTEGER)
 SELECT fact_inbound_shipment.distributor_id, fact_inbound_shipment.product_id, coalesce(sum(coalesce(anon_1.counted_qty, fact_inbound_shipment.quantity)), %(coalesce_2)s::INTEGER) AS coalesce_1 
FROM fact_inbound_shipment LEFT OUTER JOIN anon_1 ON anon_1.fact_id = fact_inbound_shipment.id 
WHERE fact_inbound_shipment.tenant_id = %(tenant_id_1)s::VARCHAR AND fact_inbound_shipment.pod_date IS NULL AND fact_inbound_shipment.distributor_id IS NOT NULL AND fact_inbound_shipment.product_id IS NOT NULL AND (anon_1.fact_id IS NULL OR anon_1.counted_qty > %(counted_qty_1)s::INTEGER) AND fact_inbound_shipment.tenant_id = %(tid_1)s::VARCHAR GROUP BY fact_inbound_shipment.distributor_id, fact_inbound_shipment.product_id

stmts.sql:
WITH anon_1 AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT anon_2.fact_id AS fact_id, CASE WHEN (anon_2.open_qty > anon_2.shipped_qty) THEN anon_2.open_qty - anon_2.shipped_qty ELSE %(param_1)s::INTEGER END AS counted_qty 
FROM (SELECT fact_inbound_shipment_1.id AS fact_id, lower(fact_inbound_shipment_1.line_state) AS state, coalesce(fact_inbound_shipment_1.quantity, %(coalesce_3)s::INTEGER) AS open_qty, sum(CASE WHEN (lower(fact_inbound_shipment_1.line_state) = %(lower_1)s::VARCHAR) THEN coalesce(fact_inbound_shipment_1.quantity, %(coalesce_4)s::INTEGER) ELSE %(param_2)s::INTEGER END) OVER (PARTITION BY fact_inbound_shipment_1.tenant_id, lower(trim(coalesce(fact_inbound_shipment_1.operating_unit, ''))), lower(trim(fact_inbound_shipment_1.order_no)), lower(trim(fact_inbound_shipment_1.item_code))) AS shipped_qty, sum(CASE WHEN (lower(fact_inbound_shipment_1.line_state) = %(lower_1)s::VARCHAR) THEN %(param_3)s::INTEGER ELSE %(param_4)s::INTEGER END) OVER (PARTITION BY fact_inbound_shipment_1.tenant_id, lower(trim(coalesce(fact_inbound_shipment_1.operating_unit, ''))), lower(trim(fact_inbound_shipment_1.order_no)), lower(trim(fact_inbound_shipment_1.item_code))) AS n_shipped 
FROM fact_inbound_shipment AS fact_inbound_shipment_1 
WHERE fact_inbound_shipment_1.order_no IS NOT NULL AND fact_inbound_shipment_1.item_code IS NOT NULL AND trim(fact_inbound_shipment_1.order_no) != '' AND trim(fact_inbound_shipment_1.item_code) != '' AND lower(fact_inbound_shipment_1.line_state) IN (%(lower_2_1)s::VARCHAR, %(lower_2_2)s::VARCHAR) AND fact_inbound_shipment_1.tenant_id = %(tid_1)s::VARCHAR) AS anon_2 
WHERE anon_2.state = %(state_1)s::VARCHAR AND anon_2.n_shipped > %(n_shipped_1)s::INTEGER)
 SELECT fact_inbound_shipment.distributor_id, fact_inbound_shipment.product_id, coalesce(sum(coalesce(anon_1.counted_qty, fact_inbound_shipment.quantity)), %(coalesce_2)s::INTEGER) AS coalesce_1 
FROM fact_inbound_shipment LEFT OUTER JOIN anon_1 ON anon_1.fact_id = fact_inbound_shipment.id 
WHERE fact_inbound_shipment.tenant_id = %(tenant_id_1)s::VARCHAR AND fact_inbound_shipment.pod_date IS NULL AND fact_inbound_shipment.distributor_id IS NOT NULL AND fact_inbound_shipment.product_id IS NOT NULL AND (anon_1.fact_id IS NULL OR anon_1.counted_qty > %(counted_qty_1)s::INTEGER) AND fact_inbound_shipment.tenant_id = %(tid_1)s::VARCHAR GROUP BY fact_inbound_shipment.distributor_id, fact_inbound_shipment.product_id

SELECT max(fact_sales_sellout.transaction_date) AS max_1 
FROM fact_sales_sellout 
WHERE fact_sales_sellout.tenant_id = %(tenant_id_1)s::VARCHAR AND fact_sales_sellout.tenant_id = %(tid_1)s::VARCHAR

SELECT max(coalesce(fact_inbound_shipment.ship_confirm_date, fact_inbound_shipment.pod_date)) AS max_1

WHERE fact_inbound_shipment.tenant_id = %(tenant_id_1)s::VARCHAR AND fact_inbound_shipment.tenant_id = %(tid_1)s::VARCHAR

stmts.label: NB /api/v1/channel-ops/cover-distribution
stmts.sql:
SELECT CAST(fact_sales_sellout.transaction_date AS DATE) - (CAST(EXTRACT(isodow FROM CAST(fact_sales_sellout.transaction_date AS DATE)) AS INTEGER) - %(param_1)s::INTEGER) AS wk, coalesce(sum(fact_sales_sellout.units), %(coalesce_2)s::INTEGER) AS coalesce_1 
FROM fact_sales_sellout 
WHERE fact_sales_sellout.tenant_id = %(tenant_id_1)s::VARCHAR AND fact_sales_sellout.transaction_date >= %(transaction_date_1)s::DATE AND fact_sales_sellout.transaction_date <= %(transaction_date_2)s::DATE AND fact_sales_sellout.tenant_id = %(tid_1)s::VARCHAR GROUP BY CAST(fact_sales_sellout.transaction_date AS DATE) - (CAST(EXTRACT(isodow FROM CAST(fact_sales_sellout.transaction_date AS DATE)) AS INTEGER) - %(param_1)s::INTEGER)
